name: 9drive-manage
description: Kelola file di 9drive (drive.komida.site) lewat REST API: list, upload, download, dan delete. Kredensial (api_key + base_url) dibaca otomatis dari ~/.smara/config.yaml, jadi tidak perlu hardcode. Pakai ini untuk cek isi 9drive, ambil/hapus file, atau upload tanpa harus build CLI.

args.command:
set -e
ACTION="__PARAM__action"
TARGET="__PARAM__target"
DEST="__PARAM__dest"
MIME="__PARAM__mime_type"
CFG="$HOME/.smara/config.yaml"

if [ ! -f "$CFG" ]; then echo "config tidak ditemukan: $CFG" >&2; exit 1; fi
API_KEY="$(grep -E '^ninedrive_api_key:' "$CFG" | head -1 | sed -E 's/^ninedrive_api_key:[[:space:]]*//' | tr -d '\"'"'"' ')"
BASE_URL="$(grep -E '^ninedrive_base_url:' "$CFG" | head -1 | sed -E 's/^ninedrive_base_url:[[:space:]]*//' | tr -d '\"'"'"' ')"
[ -z "$BASE_URL" ] && BASE_URL="http://localhost:4000"
BASE_URL="${BASE_URL%/}"; BASE_URL="${BASE_URL%/v1}"; BASE_URL="${BASE_URL%/api}"
if [ -z "$API_KEY" ]; then echo "ninedrive_api_key kosong di $CFG" >&2; exit 1; fi
AUTH="Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY"

case "$ACTION" in
  list)
    URL="$BASE_URL/api/v1/files"
    [ -n "$TARGET" ] && URL="$URL?q=$TARGET"
    RESP="$(curl -fsS -H "$AUTH" "$URL")"
    if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "$RESP" | jq -r '.files | "Total: \(length) file", (.[] | "  \(.id)  \(.sizeBytes)B  \(.status)  \(.name)")'
    else
      echo "$RESP"
    fi
    ;;
  upload)
    [ -z "$TARGET" ] && { echo "action=upload butuh target (path file)" >&2; exit 1; }
    [ -f "$TARGET" ] || { echo "file tidak ada: $TARGET" >&2; exit 1; }
    [ -z "$MIME" ] && MIME="application/octet-stream"
    SIZE="$(wc -c < "$TARGET" | tr -d ' ')"
    NAME="$(basename "$TARGET")"
    META="[{\"fieldName\":\"file-0\",\"fileName\":\"$NAME\",\"mimeType\":\"$MIME\",\"sizeBytes\":\"$SIZE\"}]"
    # filesMeta WAJIB sebelum file — server stream berdasarkan sizeBytes
    curl -fsS -H "$AUTH" -F "filesMeta=$META" -F "file-0=@$TARGET;type=$MIME" "$BASE_URL/api/v1/uploads"
    echo
    echo "\u2713 uploaded $NAME ($SIZE bytes)"
    ;;
  download)
    [ -z "$TARGET" ] && { echo "action=download butuh target (file id)" >&2; exit 1; }
    [ -z "$DEST" ] && DEST="./$TARGET"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DEST")"
    curl -fsS -H "$AUTH" -o "$DEST" "$BASE_URL/api/v1/files/$TARGET/download"
    echo "\u2713 downloaded -> $DEST"
    ;;
  delete)
    [ -z "$TARGET" ] && { echo "action=delete butuh target (file id)" >&2; exit 1; }
    curl -fsS -X DELETE -H "$AUTH" "$BASE_URL/api/v1/files/$TARGET"
    echo
    echo "\u2713 deleted $TARGET"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "action tidak dikenal: '$ACTION' (pakai: list|upload|download|delete)" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

params.name: action
params.description: Operasi yang dijalankan: list | upload | download | delete

params.name: target
params.description: Untuk upload: path file lokal. Untuk download/delete: file id. Untuk list: query nama (opsional).
